name: Electron plasma frequency
assumptions: Local electron density; cold-plasma definition.
validation_status: Not independently validated as a complete diagnostic workflow

name: Debye length
inputs: T_e [K] or convert eV using k_B T=e T_e[eV]; n_e [m^-3]
assumptions: Quasi-equilibrium Maxwellian electron approximation.
validation_status: Not independently validated as a complete diagnostic workflow

name: Electron cyclotron frequency
assumptions: Non-relativistic single-particle frequency; harmonics and relativistic shifts may matter.
validation_status: Not independently validated as a complete diagnostic workflow

name: Ion sound speed (common approximation)
assumptions: Model-dependent closure and ion species.
validation_status: Not independently validated as a complete diagnostic workflow

name: Electron thermal pressure
assumptions: Temperature represented in electron-volts.
validation_status: Not independently validated as a complete diagnostic workflow

name: Ion thermal pressure
assumptions: Sum over ion species; do not assume single-ion composition silently.
validation_status: Not independently validated as a complete diagnostic workflow

name: Total thermal pressure
assumptions: Excludes energetic/non-thermal components unless included explicitly.
validation_status: Not independently validated as a complete diagnostic workflow

name: Thermal stored energy
assumptions: Classical isotropic ideal-gas form; geometry and species definitions matter.
validation_status: Not independently validated as a complete diagnostic workflow

name: Line-integrated electron density
assumptions: A line integral; local profile needs multiple sightlines/model.
validation_status: Not independently validated as a complete diagnostic workflow

name: Plasma frequency from density
assumptions: Approximate electron plasma frequency.
validation_status: Not independently validated as a complete diagnostic workflow

name: Doppler line-of-sight velocity
inputs: Calibrated centroid shift Δλ; rest wavelength λ₀
assumptions: Non-relativistic Doppler approximation and correct viewing geometry.
validation_status: Not independently validated as a complete diagnostic workflow

name: Ion temperature from Gaussian Doppler sigma
inputs: Corrected σ_λ and λ₀ in same units; ion mass in kg for SI form
assumptions: Thermal Gaussian Doppler width only; instrument response and other broadening removed.
validation_status: Not independently validated as a complete diagnostic workflow

name: Gaussian FWHM and sigma
assumptions: Gaussian profile only.
validation_status: Not independently validated as a complete diagnostic workflow

name: Magnetic energy density
assumptions: Magnetic energy density in vacuum approximation.
validation_status: Not independently validated as a complete diagnostic workflow

name: Toroidal beta
inputs: Defined pressure average and reference toroidal field
assumptions: State volume/local average and field convention.
validation_status: Not independently validated as a complete diagnostic workflow

name: Safety factor large-aspect-ratio estimate
assumptions: Approximate circular, large-aspect-ratio geometry; equilibrium reconstruction is preferred.
validation_status: Not independently validated as a complete diagnostic workflow

name: Faraday induction
assumptions: Sign, turns, area and electronics response documented.
validation_status: Not independently validated as a complete diagnostic workflow

name: Plasma loop resistance proxy
assumptions: Only under consistent sign/definition; inductive terms can complicate interpretation.
validation_status: Not independently validated as a complete diagnostic workflow

name: Ohmic power approximation
assumptions: Not generally the same as net loss power or total input power.
validation_status: Not independently validated as a complete diagnostic workflow

name: Energy confinement time
assumptions: Use consistent boundary, time window and loss-power definition.
validation_status: Not independently validated as a complete diagnostic workflow

name: Greenwald density reference
assumptions: Empirical reference scaling, not a universal physical limit.
validation_status: Not independently validated as a complete diagnostic workflow

name: Debye parameter
assumptions: Number of particles in a Debye sphere.
validation_status: Not independently validated as a complete diagnostic workflow

name: Electron plasma angular frequency
assumptions: Local electron density.
validation_status: Not independently validated as a complete diagnostic workflow

name: Ion saturation particle flux proxy
assumptions: Converts charge current to particle flux only with valid collection geometry/model.
validation_status: Not independently validated as a complete diagnostic workflow

name: Radiated power fraction
inputs: P_rad and defined input power, both W
assumptions: Input-power convention and time averaging must be specified.
validation_status: Not independently validated as a complete diagnostic workflow

name: Integrated surface power
inputs: Heat flux q_perp [W/m²] and surface area
assumptions: Surface mapping, geometry and heat-flux calibration required.
validation_status: Not independently validated as a complete diagnostic workflow

name: Apparent feature speed
inputs: Calibrated image displacement and frame interval
assumptions: Projected apparent velocity, not necessarily plasma flow velocity.
validation_status: Not independently validated as a complete diagnostic workflow

name: Gas pumping speed
inputs: Throughput Q and pressure p in consistent units
assumptions: Gauge position, conductance and throughput convention matter.
validation_status: Not independently validated as a complete diagnostic workflow

name: Injected particle number
assumptions: Rate calibration and time base required.
validation_status: Not independently validated as a complete diagnostic workflow

name: Particle confinement time proxy
inputs: Stored particle number and loss rate
assumptions: Requires consistent control volume and particle balance.
validation_status: Not independently validated as a complete diagnostic workflow

name: Relative fluctuation level
inputs: Time series x with nonzero mean
assumptions: Window and detrending must be specified; unstable near zero mean.
validation_status: Not independently validated as a complete diagnostic workflow

name: RMS signal
assumptions: Specify whether DC component is included.
validation_status: Not independently validated as a complete diagnostic workflow

name: Nyquist frequency
assumptions: Frequencies above Nyquist alias unless anti-alias filtering was applied.
validation_status: Not independently validated as a complete diagnostic workflow

name: Cross-correlation lag
assumptions: Correlation lag does not establish causality; periodic signals can create ambiguous peaks.
validation_status: Not independently validated as a complete diagnostic workflow

name: Magnitude-squared coherence
assumptions: Estimator uncertainty depends on segment count and stationarity.
validation_status: Not independently validated as a complete diagnostic workflow

name: Bolometry inverse problem
equation: y=A x+ε; estimate x by regularized inverse
inputs: Line-integrated signals y, geometry matrix A
assumptions: Ill-posed inverse problem; save regularization and uncertainty.
validation_status: Not independently validated as a complete diagnostic workflow

name: Continuity / particle balance
inputs: Stored particles, input/output and source/loss rates
assumptions: Define volume and avoid double-counting source/loss terms.
validation_status: Not independently validated as a complete diagnostic workflow
